Preprocess Illumina 10X Genomics GEX / antibody capture / HTO data by library - from Cell Ranger raw matrix

+ CITE-seq: cell-surface protein measurements
+ Cell Hashing: tagged antibodies against ubiquitous cell surface proteins to multiplex samples

Code adapted from:

+ https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/hashing_vignette
+ https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/multimodal_vignette
+ Meijie/Shaoli code (CCRGB-42)
+ https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/dsb/vignettes/end_to_end_workflow.html

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dsb)
```

# Create Seurat object

## Get h5 file location

```{r}
library <- params$library
input_dir <- params$input_dir
output_dir <- params$output_dir
hashtags <- strsplit(params$hashtags,",")[[1]]

h5_file <- paste(input_dir,library,"outs/multi/count/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5",sep="/")

print(paste("Using input file:", h5_file))
```

## Load h5 data

Assumes data includes only shared barcodes

```{r}
library.data <- Read10X_h5(h5_file)

# Simplify feature names
rownames(library.data[["Antibody Capture"]]) <- gsub(pattern = "_*TotalSeqC", replacement = "",rownames(library.data[["Antibody Capture"]]))
```

## Create Seurat object 

Initialize with RNA, add ADT and HTO assays 

```{r}
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = library.data[["Gene Expression"]],project=library)
seurat_obj[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = library.data[["Antibody Capture"]][5:22,])
seurat_obj[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = library.data[["Antibody Capture"]][hashtags,])
```

Remove cells with few RNA reads to fix the HTODemux error (will likely be removed during HTO demultiplexing anyway).

```{r}
seurat_obj <- subset(seurat_obj,nCount_RNA > 100)
```

# Normalize data 

Log normalization for RNA, CLR transformation for antibodies

+ HTO: margin=1 for normalization across feature
+ CITE-seq: margin=2 for normalization within the cell, accounting for differences in ADT depth across cells (https://github.com/satijalab/seurat/issues/8159)
* Overwritten by DSB normalization after HTO demultiplexing

```{r}
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2)
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", normalization.method = "CLR")
```

# Demultiplex samples by HTO

HTODemux performs clustering on normalized values to separate cells into K(number of samples)+1 clusters. For each HTO, classifies each cell as positive or negative/ambiguous, with cross-sample doublets positive for more than one.

Commonly gives an error due to 0 counts (based on Seurat issues, common).

```{r, eval=FALSE}
seurat_obj <- HTODemux(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", positive.quantile = 0.9999)
```

Alternatively, use MULTIseqDemux as workaround (default parameters).

```{r}
seurat_obj <- MULTIseqDemux(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO")
```

## Visualize demultiplexing results

```{r}
# Classification summary
table(seurat_obj$MULTI_ID)

# Number of UMIs by classification
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "MULTI_ID"
VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = "nCount_RNA", log = TRUE)

# Ridge plot for HTO signals
RidgePlot(seurat_obj, assay = "HTO", features = rownames(seurat_obj[["HTO"]]),ncol=2)

# Visualize pairs to confirm mutual exclusivity
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- "HTO"
for (i in 1:(length(hashtags) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(hashtags)) {
    print(FeatureScatter(seurat_obj, feature1 = hashtags[i], feature2 = hashtags[j]))
  }
}

# Remove negative cells from the object
seurat_obj.subset <- subset(seurat_obj, idents = "Negative", invert = TRUE)

# Plot PCA on HTO data
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj.subset) <- "HTO"
seurat_obj.subset <- ScaleData(seurat_obj.subset, features = rownames(seurat_obj.subset),verbose = FALSE)
seurat_obj.subset <- RunPCA(seurat_obj.subset, features = rownames(seurat_obj.subset), approx = FALSE)
DimPlot(seurat_obj.subset)
```

## Extract singlets and negatives

```{r}
seurat_obj.singlet <- subset(seurat_obj.subset, idents = "Doublet", invert = TRUE)
seurat_obj.negative <- subset(seurat_obj, idents = "Negative")
rm(seurat_obj.subset)
```

# ADT normalization with DSB

Removes ambient noise using empty droplets and uses non-specific isotype controls to remove inter-cell technical variation.

```{r}
isotypes = c("Mm-IgG1-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl","Mm-IgG2a-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl","Mm-IgG2b-Kappa-isotype-Ctrl")

seurat_obj.singlet[["ADT"]]$data = DSBNormalizeProtein(cell_protein_matrix = seurat_obj.singlet[["ADT"]]$counts, 
                                     empty_drop_matrix = seurat_obj.negative[["ADT"]]$counts, 
                                     denoise.counts = TRUE,
                                     use.isotype.control = TRUE, 
                                     isotype.control.name.vec = isotypes,
                                     fast.km = TRUE)
```

# GEX QC and filtering

```{r}
seurat_obj.singlet[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj.singlet, assay = "RNA", pattern = "^MT-")

VlnPlot(seurat_obj.singlet, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
hist(seurat_obj.singlet$nFeature_RNA)
hist(seurat_obj.singlet$percent.mt)

print(paste("Number of genes:",params$nFeature_RNA_min,"-",params$nFeature_RNA_max))
print(paste("% MT:",params$percent.mt_max))
seurat_obj.singlet.filtered <- subset(seurat_obj.singlet, subset = nFeature_RNA > params$nFeature_RNA_min & 
                                        nFeature_RNA < params$nFeature_RNA_max & 
                                        percent.mt < params$percent.mt_max)
table(seurat_obj.singlet.filtered$MULTI_ID)
VlnPlot(seurat_obj.singlet.filtered, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
```

# Save object

```{r}
saveRDS(seurat_obj.singlet, file = paste(output_dir,"/",library,".singlet.rds",sep=""))
saveRDS(seurat_obj.singlet.filtered, file = paste(output_dir,"/",library,".singlet.filtered.rds",sep=""))
```
